consequence: predictive_orthonormal holds size on ADNI's blocks at every design point under RRPP's unrestricted draws: SEA-AD's excess does not transfer to ADNI. The size part of open item 1's second condition is met for ADNI. It stays an opt-in diagnostic until the gain and specificity readings at ADNI's design, the next change. The fixed-rank grade says whether the hold is owed to ADNI's noise or to the ranks its CV selects. In every verdict the SEA-AD anchor's reading stands for SEA-AD's design, and keep_production stands.

consequences.excess_absent: predictive_orthonormal holds size on ADNI's blocks at every design point under RRPP's unrestricted draws: SEA-AD's excess does not transfer to ADNI. The size part of open item 1's second condition is met for ADNI. It stays an opt-in diagnostic until the gain and specificity readings at ADNI's design, the next change. consequences.excess_persists: The excess appears at ADNI's own design, at 0.2 features per participant, so item 19's prediction for ADNI is refuted. The veto rests on two cohorts and the second reopening condition of open item 1 is closed for ADNI. predictive_orthonormal stays an opt-in diagnostic.
consequences.excess_scoped: predictive_orthonormal holds size on ADNI's blocks from the named point up to the cohort and exceeds below it. The size part of open item 1's second condition is met for ADNI inside that scope only. It stays an opt-in diagnostic; the gain and specificity readings at ADNI's design are the next change and are confined to the scope.
consequences.gate_failed: No reading is interpreted. The cause is fixed and the affected units are rerun under the same rule.
consequences.production_excess: Production's unrestricted null with df exceeds size on ADNI's noise at the named readings. No reading of predictive_orthonormal is interpreted at a point where production fails. A diagnosis of those points comes before any other reading on ADNI. If the cohort is among them, the roadmap states that a rejection at ADNI's design lacks a size-controlled null on its own noise; the case study's primary non-rejections stand, since an excess cannot produce them.

descriptive_note: Features per participant, the selected ranks and the in-sample stage fit describe the design points; they license no reading at another design (S5). Every table under 'descriptive' is a reading beside the verdict and the grade and never changes them.

fixed_rank.rule: one family per combination of coordinates and null: three statistics at every fixed rank on every subsampled point and at the ranks other than the cohort's on the cohort, judged by the count-plus-ceiling rule; it never changes the verdict
fixed_rank.statement: An over-fitted rank mis-sizes the scores themselves on ADNI's noise. The predictive arms are reported without a grade, and the roadmap records that production's size depends on a rank its CV does not select here.

statements.absent: No excess at either fixed rank. An over-fitted stage fit is not sufficient on ADNI's noise: SEA-AD's excess needs a property of its blocks this ladder lacks. The lead is a feature-subsampling ladder on SEA-AD's own export, then ROSMAP.
statements.reference_exceeds: An over-fitted rank mis-sizes the scores themselves on ADNI's noise. The predictive arms are reported without a grade, and the roadmap records that production's size depends on a rank its CV does not select here.
statements.reproduced: ADNI's noise gives the predictive subspace the excess once the fit is over-fitted, and the within-stage draws remove it. Item 19's mechanism is not specific to SEA-AD's blocks. The report tabulates the excess against the in-sample stage fit.
statements.reproduced_unrestored: The excess appears at an over-fitted rank and the within-stage draws do not remove it at the named readings. Unequal stage dispersion is not the whole mechanism on ADNI's noise; the dispersion table and the out-of-fold shares are the leads.

scoping_rule.S1: A size reading speaks for its export and its design points. The points are declared before the run. Nothing is interpolated between them or extended beyond them.
scoping_rule.S2: An option's scope on a cohort is its size scope (design D8). An option with no scope there is not admissible on that cohort.
scoping_rule.S3: Cohorts do not vouch for one another. A hold on one export does not lift a failure on another and does not extend to a cohort without its own reading. The SEA-AD anchor's reading stands for SEA-AD's design.
scoping_rule.S4: Size is one of three readings. Reopening an option at a design also needs a gain over production at that design in simulation and specificity there, each under a decision declared before its reading. Reopening means that a separate change may propose its paper-grade run; only that run can change a default.
scoping_rule.S5: Covariates describe; they do not extend. Features per participant, the selected ranks and the in-sample stage fit are reported beside a scope. They license no reading at a design that was not read.

size_scope_note: A scope is the size part of open item 1's reopening condition only; the gain over production in simulation at ADNI's design and specificity there are still missing, each under its own predeclared decision.
standing: In every verdict the SEA-AD anchor's reading stands for SEA-AD's design, and keep_production stands.
